topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I didn't mean for you to find the pages hidden under the old rug. It started as just a story, a way to pass the time when the days felt long and you weren’t there. But as I wrote, the lines blurred. I couldn’t help but use the echoes of our life, the laughter we shared, and the whispers of our secrets. Now, seeing the surprise on your face, I wish I had told you first. I should have shared this part of me, this quiet corner where I played with words and captured moments. I’ll put the pen down, if that’s what you want.
